WeddingEvent.title: WeddingEvent
WeddingEvent.description: Configuration and schedule details for the wedding invitation.

eventId.description: Identifier for the wedding event (always main_wedding).

coupleNames.description: Display string for the couple names.

brideName.description: First or full name of the bride.

groomName.description: First or full name of the groom.

dayOfWeek.description: Day of the week for the ceremony.

venueAddress.description: Full street address of the venue.

city.description: City and state of the venue.

eventType.description: Type of celebration (e.g., Muhurtham & Grand Reception).

mapUrl.description: Optional Google Maps URL for venue directions.

coverSubtitle.description: Short welcoming sentence on the invitation cover.

welcomeMessage.description: Heartfelt welcome message from the couple and family.

familyMessage.description: Short note from the family on the event details page.

maxGuestsPerRsvp.description: Maximum number of guests allowed per single RSVP submission.

schedule.description: Ordered list of wedding itinerary events (up to 10 items).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last configuration update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the admin who updated the event.

GuestInvitation.title: GuestInvitation
GuestInvitation.description: Public-safe invitation token record without PII phone numbers.

inviteToken.description: Unpredictable invitation token matching document ID.

guestDisplayName.description: Name of the invited guest or family shown on the cover.

maxAllowedGuests.description: Maximum allowed attendees for this specific invitation.

status.description: Current response status of the invitation.

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who generated the invitation.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when invitation was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when invitation was last updated.

RsvpResponse.title: RsvpResponse
RsvpResponse.description: Isolated guest RSVP record containing private mobile number and meal preference.

rsvpId.description: Document ID of the RSVP response.

fullName.description: Full name of the responding guest.

mobileNumber.description: Validated mobile phone number of the guest (PII - admin only read).

attendanceStatus.description: Whether the guest will attend or decline.

attendeeCount.description: Number of attending guests (0 if declined, 1..15 if confirmed).

mealPreference.description: Dietary preference (vegetarian, non-vegetarian, or none if declined).

messageToFamily.description: Optional warm wishes or note from the guest to the family.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp of initial RSVP submission.

/events/{eventId}.description: Publicly readable wedding event details and schedule; writable only by verified admin.

/invitations/{inviteToken}.description: Token-addressable invitation metadata without PII; individual get allowed by token, list/create/delete restricted to verified admin.

/rsvps/{rsvpId}.description: Guest RSVP submissions containing PII mobile numbers; public create with strict schema validation, read/update/delete restricted strictly to verified admin.
